The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster. Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI. Join us and change the world. Role Overview We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (.NET / AI) to help build and scale the next generation of applications for one of our growing enterprise clients. This is a senior-level engineering role with a strong backend focus, combining modern full-stack development with AI-powered application development. You will be responsible for architecting and building scalable systems, establishing development standards, integrating Generative AI solutions into production environments, and driving technical decisions across multiple initiatives. The role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building systems from scratch, and can operate as a highly autonomous technical leader while collaborating closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders. Exceptional Leadership As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you — if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you. Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea. One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone. Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve — our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen. Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you. Player-coach: You fly high and low. You understand the strategy while staying close to the details that matter. You roll up your sleeves, stay hands-on, and empower others without micromanaging. Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert;  you approach your workthrough the lens of solving business problems. Key Responsibilities Backend Architecture & Development Design, build, and maintain scalable backend systems using .NET and C#. Architect robust APIs, services, and application infrastructure that support current and future products. Establish engineering standards, best practices, and maintainable system architectures. Drive technical decisions that improve scalability, reliability, security, and performance. Full-Stack Development Collaborate with frontend teams working in React to deliver end-to-end application functionality. Contribute across the full stack when needed while maintaining a strong backend focus. Ensure seamless integration between frontend experiences and backend services. Support application modernization and continuous improvement initiatives. AI & Generative AI Integration Design and implement Generative AI solutions within production applications. Evaluate and integrate LLM-powered capabilities that improve business processes and operational efficiency. Build AI-enabled workflows, automation systems, and intelligent application features. Stay current with emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to create business value. Technical Leadership & Solution Design Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership across projects. Make informed technology decisions in environments with evolving requirements and limited structure. Lead solution design discussions and identify the best approaches for implementation. Drive engineering excellence through mentorship, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Partner with leadership to align technical strategy with business goals. Participate in planning, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. Ensure solutions are delivered with high quality and maintainability. Qualifications & Competencies Experience 8+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend development. Extensive hands-on experience with .NET and C#. Strong full-stack development experience with modern web application architectures. Experience building and deploying production-grade applications. Experience working in startup, scale-up, or high-growth environments. AI & Modern Engineering Proven experience integrating Generative AI solutions into production applications. Hands-on experience working with LLMs, AI-powered workflows, or intelligent automation systems. Understanding of AI orchestration patterns, agentic workflows, or AI application architecture. Experience evaluating and implementing emerging AI technologies. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of software architecture, system design, APIs, and distributed systems. Experience designing scalable and maintainable backend services. Deep understanding of modern development practices, testing strategies, and deployment workflows. Strong problem-solving and debugging capabilities. Leadership & Communication Excellent communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. Ability to operate independently and make high-impact technical decisions. Comfortable navigating ambiguity and changing priorities. Strong ownership mentality and accountability for outcomes. Nice to Have Experience with Claude and AI orchestration frameworks. Experience with AI agents, RAG architectures, or advanced LLM implementation patterns. Experience building products or platforms from scratch. Experience leading technical teams or serving as a technical lead. Experience working in highly autonomous engineering environments. What We’re Looking For We're looking for someone who is more than a software developer. The ideal candidate is a senior engineer who can own technical outcomes, architect scalable solutions, integrate AI into real-world products, and operate with minimal oversight. You should be comfortable making architectural decisions, solving complex backend challenges, collaborating across functions, and leveraging AI technologies to create business impact. This role is best suited for someone who is highly autonomous, technically strong, product-minded, and excited about building the future of AI-enabled software systems. Role Details Location : Remote (LATAM / Americas) Time Zone : Must maintain a minimum of 6 hours overlap with US working hours Contract Type : Contracting Duration : 12 Months Expected Start Date : 22 June 2026 Assessment Path : .NET Required Technologies : .NET, C#, React, TypeScript, Generative AI Apply Now Apply now to join Andela's global talent network and support the development of next-generation AI-powered applications for a fast-growing technology-driven organization. This is an excellent opportunity for a Senior Software Engineer, Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Lead Software Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Backend Engineer who enjoys modern architecture, AI-powered development, technical leadership, and building scalable systems from the ground up.

title: Data Product Associate
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Data Product Associate em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About YipitData: YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare. Our insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B, further accelerating our growth and market impact. We have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency. With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets. About the Role: We currently have 60+ Data team members in our Investor business who build, create and maintain our data products, and we are looking to further expand the team to continue to increase our product portfolio. Those with strong analytical skills who are passionate about data and excited to scale quickly to deliver top-tier products to our clients are encouraged to apply. At YipitData, we value ownership and impact. Your growth is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. Our career ladder also rewards strong performance with regular opportunities for compensation increases and promotions. See this short video to learn more about our organization, product, and why some of our current data team members love working here! As a Data Associate, you will: Own high-impact data products end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency. You’ll ramp quickly into full ownership of your products and workflows, operating with minimal oversight. Work with massive amounts of data to answer our clients’ key questions about the companies and datasets we analyze. You’ll develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights. Tackle complex data problems independently, using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require innovative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous. Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — significantly increasing speed, reducing manual work, and beginning to automate portions of workflows. You’ll standardize best practices and build repeatable processes, always maintaining a high bar for correctness and quality while validating AI-generated outputs. Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop technical solutions that streamline workflows, optimize data processes, and push the boundaries of automation. Identify and drive improvements to products and data pipelines, contributing ideas for new products, enhancements, and features. This could include developing new methodologies, exploring and scaling the use of new third-party datasets, or improving product profitability — all with a clear understanding of what drives value for clients. You Are Likely To Succeed If: You have 4–5+ years of experience in data, business, or predictive analytics and are proficient in SQL, Python, and PySpark You have a proven track record of quickly learning new concepts, particularly complex data methodologies, and building strong mental models of how and why data works You actively use AI tools (e.G., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate your work and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — both orally and in writing You have a strong ownership mentality and are enthusiastic about making a big impact at a rapidly growing company You can manage multiple projects simultaneously, independently prioritize tasks, and make sound decisions with incomplete information You have experience using sample or panel data to make precise estimates that guide decision-making You have a background in financial markets or are interested in learning more about data-driven investing You have an Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher) For You: Flexible PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) Flexible work schedule Personal laptop Health and wellness package Remote work We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Vendedor (Closer) Presencial
description:

Campinas, SP | Vaga Presencial PJ    Sabe aquele filme onde o protagonista encontra o trabalho perfeito? Pois é. Essa é sua audição. A LikePlay Filmes produz conteúdo original para Amazon Prime Video, VivoPlay, NetNow e nossa própria plataforma de streaming. Mas não paramos por aí: criamos o Zero ao Set Plus , um programa que transforma pessoas comuns em atores profissionais com participação GARANTIDA em nossas produções.  E agora precisamos de você  para converter sonhadores em estrelas do cinema.  SUA MISSÃO (CASO ACEITE)   Você vai atender por videochamada pessoas de todo o Brasil que sonham em ser atores. Sua agenda? Já vem prontinha, nosso sistema qualifica e agenda para você. Os leads? Atraidos pelo nosso marketing irresistível. Você só faz o que sabe fazer de melhor: vender.   O produto é simples de entender: formação em atuação para tv e cinema completa + garantia de atuar em produção real. Investimento de um Ticket médio R$3.100. E cada venda? Muda uma vida de verdade.  O QUE VOCÊ GANHA?   Ajuda de custo:  Fixo R$36k/ano (R$3.000/mês), Comissões:  Somadas vão de 10% a 14% e podem triplicar ou quadruplicar  sua renda total (Nossos vendedores top faturam tranquilamente R$8k a R$15k/mês) Esquema:  Seg a sex, horário comercial, presencial em Campinas, mas com  flexibilidade REAL pra trabalhar de casa quando precisar.  POR QUE ESSA VAGA É DIFERENTE?    Porque você não vai vender "mais um curso online". Vai vender o momento que uma criança, adolescente ou até mesmo um adulto vai lembrar pro resto da vida. O dia que uma mãe de 35 realizou um sonho antigo. A virada de chave de um jovem que sempre quis, mas nunca soube como. Cada venda sua vira um novo nome nos créditos finais de uma série. Cada contrato fechado pode ser o "antes e depois" de alguém.   E convenhamos: quantos vendedores podem dizer que vão dormir felizes sabendo que ajudaram alguém a aparecer nas telonas do cinema ou streamings?  O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?   Experiência com vendas (de preferência consultivas ou inside sales) Jogo de cintura pra negociar e fechar por videochamada Organização pra gerenciar seu funil e bater metas Comunicação afiada, você vai vender sonhos com método, não papo furado Vontade de trabalhar numa empresa descolada que está quebrando as regras do mercado tradicional Diferencial:  Conhecimento em CRM e gestão comercial Essencial:  Acreditar que dá pra vender com propósito E ganhar bem fazendo isso  ESTRUTURA QUE FUNCIONA   Aqui você não fica sozinho inventando a roda: ✓ Sistema de SDR qualifica e monta sua agenda  (você não perde tempo prospectando) ✓ Marketing gera leads quentes  (gente que JÁ quer o produto) ✓ CRM organizado  (funil claro, processo definido) ✓ Produto que vende sozinho  (quando a pessoa entende, ela QUER), o maior desafio é a desconfiança. Confiou em você? Contrato fechado....  Seu trabalho é converter. E ganhar bem com isso.  SOBRE NÓS   LikePlay Filmes não é só produtora, é movimento. Já dirigimos mais de 7 mil atores, distribuímos conteúdo em plataformas gigantes e criamos um ecossistema completo pra quem quer viver de audiovisual no Brasil.  Somos a empresa que democratiza o acesso ao cinema. E precisamos de gente que venda isso com a mesma garra que a gente produz.  LUZES, CÂMERA, CARREIRA!   Se você tem fome de resultado, gosta de desafios e quer trabalhar num lugar onde cada venda realmente importa , essa vaga é sua. Não é só mais um trabalho comum. É a chance de ser lembrado como a pessoa que ajudou alguém a realizar um sonho.  Candidata-se agora e vem fazer parte dessa história.

Get ready to architect cutting-edge solutions, mentor budding talents, and infuse innovation into our deployment processes. Armed with your expertise in automation, cloud services, and system administration, you'll be instrumental in shaping the future of our technological landscape. If you're passionate about driving change and leaving a lasting impact, this is the role for you.  What Will I Do?   What will my main tasks be? You'll strategically develop and maintain advanced CI/CD pipelines, integrating the latest tools and techniques to streamline our deployment processes.  How will I contribute to the team? Your role is pivotal in architecting and managing robust, scalable cloud infrastructure solutions, harnessing the power of cutting-edge cloud services to propel us forward.  Will I collaborate with other departments? Absolutely! You'll work closely with product owners and client services to ensure our solutions resonate with our clients and meet their evolving needs.  What methodologies will I be using? You'll embrace Agile methodologies, ensuring our projects are executed efficiently and effectively, driving innovation and continuous improvement.  Are You the Right Fit?   Do you have extensive experience with DevOps? We're seeking candidates with over 5 years of hands-on experience in the DevOps realm, ready to take on the next challenge.  How familiar are you with coding best practices? Proficiency in SOLID and clean coding principles, especially in the context of scalable solutions, is a must-have for this role.  What's your experience with code reviews and automated testing? We're looking for candidates with extensive experience in conducting code reviews, writing automated tests, and implementing CI/CD pipelines, leveraging a variety of programming languages.  Can you demonstrate expertise in testing? Strong expertise in both unit testing and integration testing is essential, with a focus on maintaining high code coverage to ensure the reliability of our software solutions.  How do you approach technical decision-making? We're seeking someone who can make informed technical decisions and tailor approaches to suit each unique use case, driving innovation and efficiency.  What is your level of knowledge in IT infrastructure? A solid understanding of IT infrastructure is crucial for this role, ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and secure.  Is your English proficiency at an advanced level? Advanced proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in our global environment, fostering collaboration and understanding across teams.  Are you located in Argentina? Candidates must reside in Argentina to be eligible for this position.  What Would Be a Plus?   Do you have experience with CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab, or CircleCI? Experience with these tools will give you a head start in tackling our DevOps challenges.  Are you well-versed in system security principles? A strong understanding of system security and the ability to implement and manage robust security policies for cloud-based systems will be highly valued in this role.  Are you available to work on call when needed? Availability to work on call demonstrates your commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of our systems, even during critical times.  What We Offer   Remote Work: Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere, shaping your ideal work environment. Competitive Compensation: Choose between compensation options in USD or your local currency, tailored to your financial preferences. Home Office Equipment: We provide the necessary tech to ensure you have a comfortable and efficient home workspace. Flexible Work Schedule: Create a work schedule that aligns with your lifestyle, giving you the freedom to balance work and life. Comprehensive Leave: Take advantage of paid parental leave, vacation time, and observed national holidays. Cultural Diversity: Immerse yourself in a multicultural workplace that celebrates innovation and creativity. Elite Teamwork: Collaborate with top industry professionals, learning and growing with the best. Career Support: Benefit from a nurturing environment focused on mentorship, skill development, and varied growth opportunities.

title: Regional Study Director, Latam

This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team.Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:These may include but are not limited to:Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM.Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM.May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM.Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc.Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs.Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation.Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives.Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities.Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors.Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms.Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate.Outline regional activation hurdles for team.Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities.Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed.Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs;  maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed.Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations.Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed.Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results.Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals.Make timely, data-driven decisions.Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports.Other duties as assigned.Required Education and Experience:Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered.12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role.Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements.Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems.Excellent understanding of drug development process.Experience in clinical trial supply management.Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward.Effective verbal and written communication skills.Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution.Analysis and report generation.Knowledge of local regulatory requirements.Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential.Study initiation procedures.Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate actionTravel:You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Role Overview: As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness. Key Qualifications: Chinese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Chinese with a high degree of comp, as Chinese is the focus language for this project. Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment. Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team. Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality. Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities. Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections. Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating. Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers. Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting. Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection. Description: In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve: Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences. Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied. Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations. Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic\ "overnarrating\". Rigorouslyevaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable. Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation. Extracting and verifying\ "Debug Info\" from the modelto confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized. Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history. Education & Experience: BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.G., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field). Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week) Engagement type: Contractor Engagement Length: 3 months After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Data Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology, components and comprehensive services. Used across diverse industries, they enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes globally.  We are looking for a Data Engineer  Roles And Responsibilities   Data Architecture & Infrastructure  Design and implement a unified data warehouse and/or data lake capable of serving multiple analytics and AI workloads. Define the overall data architecture strategy, including storage layers, access patterns, and scalability approach. Define the data extraction and landing strategy, partitioning and SCD (slowly changing dimensions), data modelling strategy and consumption ports.   Pipeline Development & Integration  Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines consuming data from multiple enterprise source systems (ERP, CRM, operational tools, and others). Develop pipelines using Databricks (Lakeflow Connect) & Azure Data Factory as primary platforms. Ensure pipeline reliability, scalability, and observability through monitoring, alerting, and logging.   Data Quality & Governance  Establish and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and anomaly detection processes. Implement data cataloguing, lineage tracking, and documentation practices to ensure transparency and auditability. Define naming conventions, schema standards, and access control policies in coordination with stakeholders.   Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement  Work closely with data scientists, BI analysts, and developers within the team to ensure data products meet downstream requirements. Translate business requirements from non-technical stakeholders into robust data models and pipeline logic. Actively contribute to sprint planning and technical decision-making within an agile team environment.   Continuous Improvement  Monitor and optimize query performance, pipeline efficiency, and infrastructure cost. Stay current with developments in data engineering tooling, cloud platforms, and best practices. Contribute to the team's knowledge base through documentation and internal knowledge-sharing.   Profile And Qualifications   Minimum 5 years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related field. Expert-level proficiency in SQL — including complex query design, performance tuning, and schema modeling. Hands-on experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and pipeline orchestration. Proven experience designing and implementing data warehouse or data lake solutions at enterprise scale. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT design patterns, data modeling methodologies (star schema, data vault, etc.), and pipeline orchestration. Experience integrating data from heterogeneous source systems (ERP platforms, APIs, flat files, operational databases). Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Professional-level proficiency in Spanish;  working English is a strong advantage.

Facilidades para o dia a dia:   -  Vale-Transporte;   Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.   Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.  Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Nova vaga disponível para Vendedor(a) de loja - shopping iguatemi campinas em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

-    Ensino médio completo. -    Experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente será considerada um diferencial. -    Domínio em técnicas de vendas (7 passos) e negociação. -    Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em ambiente dinâmico de varejo. -    Capacidade de comunicação eficaz, proatividade e postura ética no atendimento. -    Atenção a detalhes, organização e comprometimento com a qualidade do serviço. -    Facilidade para aprender e aplicar processos internos (POPs) e normas da empresa. -    Habilidade para lidar com metas e resultados. -    Noções básicas de informática para uso de sistemas de ponto de venda e controle. -    Disponibilidade para horários flexíveis, incluindo finais de semana e feriados. Responsabilidades:  Ser referência na execução dos 7 passos da venda e na aplicação das JDDs, oferecendo aos clientes soluções completas em tecnologia e inovação que atendam às suas necessidades e estilo de vida, garantindo uma experiência de compra excepcional. Além disso, contribuir para a rentabilidade da empresa por meio do alcance das metas de P+S+A, assegurando equilíbrio entre a performance individual e os resultados do negócio. Atribuições: -   Preparar-se para o atendimento e a venda: Zelar pela apresentação pessoal e postura profissional, checar o estoque, atualizar-se sobre estratégias, metas da semana e campanhas vigentes. Garantir que esteja pronto para oferecer uma experiência premium ao cliente. -   Ter conhecimento profundo sobre produtos e técnicas de vendas: Assegurar adesão mínima de 90% aos treinamentos (online/presenciais), estudar materiais técnicos e manter-se atualizado sobre lançamentos e inovações, oferecendo recomendações consultivas ao cliente. -   Manter padrão de excelência no atendimento: Estar presente no fast point e seguir com disciplina o POP dos 7 passos da venda. -   Oferecer atendimento consultivo e personalizado ao cliente: Identificar necessidades, realizar perguntas exploratórias, ouvir atentamente e apresentar soluções adequadas ao estilo de vida do cliente. Explorar o PDV e os espaços JDDs de forma estratégica. -   Realizar o pós-venda: Acompanhar a satisfação do cliente, verificar entregas e instalações, oferecer suporte em caso de dúvidas, estimular recompra e fortalecer o relacionamento de longo prazo. -   Promover lançamento de produtos: Estudar diferenciais, comunicar novidades, realizar demonstrações envolventes e aplicar técnicas que reforcem o valor agregado. -   Trabalhar orientado para metas e resultados: Monitorar performance individual, acompanhar evolução das vendas e oferecer negociações saudáveis para cliente e empresa. Estar aberto a feedbacks e reajustar estratégias quando necessário. -   Gerenciar carteira de clientes: Acompanhar hábitos de consumo, personalizar contatos, antecipar necessidades futuras e enviar promoções direcionadas. -   Atualizar etiquetas de preço e garantir informações corretas aos clientes: Conferir diariamente valores dos produtos, ajustar etiquetas sempre que houver alterações e assegurar clareza na comunicação de preços e condições de pagamento. -   Manter e zelar pelo ambiente da loja: Atuar proativamente na organização, limpeza, reposição de produtos e atualização dos espaços JDDs. Positivar sistemas de segurança, garantir funcionamento de produtos e equipamentos e comunicar anomalias ao superior imediato. -   Garantir processo de checkout: Efetuar corretamente a cobrança, respeitando os meios de pagamento (débito, crédito, PIX, boleto, etc.), além de realizar o fechamento do caixa ao final do expediente.

title: Supervisor(a) de loja - shopping iguatemi campinas
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Supervisor(a) de loja - shopping iguatemi campinas em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

-         Ensino Superior Completo. -         Experiência anterior como supervisor (a) ou em áreas relacionadas, preferencialmente no varejo. -         Habilidade com as ferramentas Excel, Power BI e Power Point e sistemas de gestão de estoque e vendas (GAN, SAP, SITEF e Neogrid). -         Experiência desejável com indicadores em empresas do varejo. -         Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e em um ambiente dinâmico de varejo. -         Capacidade de comunicação eficaz e proatividade no atendimento aos clientes. -         Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horários flexíveis, incluindo finais de semana e feriados. -         Apoio Operacional: Colaborar ativamente com o Gerente de Loja no treinamento, desenvolvimento e acompanhamento da equipe para garantir um desempenho consistente. -         Gestão de Abertura: Garantir a abertura pontual da loja, seguindo escala estabelecida e protocolos de segurança, criando um ambiente seguro e acolhedor. -         Controle de Perdas: Implementar e monitorar os POPs da loja para reduzir perdas, identificando e corrigindo possíveis brechas nos processos. -         Gestão de Processos: Supervisionar os processos de troca de produtos conforme os POPs da empresa, garantindo uma experiência positiva para o cliente. -         Gestão de Pessoas: Apoiar o Gerente de Loja na gestão de pessoal e na elaboração da escala de trabalho, assegurando a cobertura adequada e o cumprimento das normas trabalhistas. -         Manutenção e Relatório: Realizar rondas operacionais para identificar e relatar anomalias, garantindo a limpeza, organização e bom funcionamento da loja. -         Ética e Conformidade: Agir conforme as normas de conduta e ética da empresa, garantindo que todas as atividades sejam realizadas de acordo com os valores estabelecidos. -         Otimização de Performance: Colaborar na maximização da margem de lucro dos vendedores, fornecendo suporte, orientação e feedback para melhorar o desempenho individual e da equipe.

title: Ux designer pleno
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) UX/Product Designer Pleno II para atuar em uma das maiores empresas de tecnologia do Brasil, contribuindo diretamente para a construção e evolução de produtos digitais que geram impacto em escala. Buscamos uma pessoa com forte visão de produto, autonomia, pensamento analítico e capacidade de transformar desafios complexos em experiências intuitivas, eficientes e orientadas a resultados. Experiência em pesquisa com usuários e testes de usabilidade.  Domínio de ferramentas de prototipação e design de interfaces.  Capacidade de atuar com autonomia na definição de métodos, entregáveis e priorização de atividades.  Conhecimento em ambientes ágeis e trabalho com times multidisciplinares.  Excelente comunicação, organização e storytelling.  Inglês fluente. Diferenciais Espanhol fluente como terceira lingua  Experiência em produtos digitais complexos e ambientes enterprise.  Conhecimento em Design Systems.  Vivência em indústria, operações, automação ou tecnologia.  Experiência atuando em múltiplas squads simultaneamente.  Familiaridade com Inteligência Artificial aplicada ao processo de Design. O que esperamos de você Perfil protagonista e orientado a resultados.  Mentalidade baseada em dados e evidências.  Facilidade para navegar em contextos complexos e multidisciplinares.  Curiosidade, senso crítico e aprendizado contínuo.  Capacidade de influenciar decisões através de uma visão estratégica de produto e experiência.
